versos.hebraico: וַיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י קָרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו וּלְזִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
controles.kjv: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
controles.livre: E foi no dia oitavo, que Moisés chamou a Arão e a seus filhos, e aos anciãos de Israel;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַח־לְ֠ךָ עֵ֣גֶל בֶּן־בָּקָ֧ר לְחַטָּ֛את וְאַ֥יִל לְעֹלָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וְהַקְרֵ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the Lord.
controles.livre: E disse a Arão: Toma das vacas um bezerro para expiação, e um carneiro para holocausto, sem defeito, e oferece-os diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר קְח֤וּ שְׂעִיר־עִזִּים֙ לְחַטָּ֔את וְעֵ֨גֶל וָכֶ֧בֶשׂ בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה תְּמִימִ֖ם לְעֹלָֽה׃

controles.web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;
controles.kjv: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
controles.livre: E aos filhos de Israel falarás, dizendo: Tomai um bode macho para expiação, e um bezerro e um cordeiro de ano, sem mácula, para holocausto;

versos.hebraico: וְשׁ֨וֹר וָאַ֜יִל לִשְׁלָמִ֗ים לִזְבֹּ֨חַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָ֖ה בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן כִּ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם יְהוָ֖ה נִרְאָ֥ה אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”
controles.kjv: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the Lord will appear unto you.
controles.livre: Também um boi e um carneiro para sacrifício pacífico, que imoleis diante do SENHOR; e uma oferta de cereais amassada com azeite: porque o SENHOR se aparecerá hoje a vós.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְח֗וּ אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־פְּנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the Lord.
controles.livre: E levaram o que mandou Moisés diante do tabernáculo do testemunho, e chegou-se toda a congregação, e puseram-se diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה זֶ֧ה הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ וְיֵרָ֥א אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do: and Yahweh’s glory shall appear to you.”
controles.kjv: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the Lord shall appear unto you.
controles.livre: Então Moisés disse: Isto é o que mandou o SENHOR; fazei-o, e a glória do SENHOR se vos aparecerá.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְרַ֤ב אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ וַעֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת־חַטָּֽאתְךָ֙ וְאֶת־עֹ֣לָתֶ֔ךָ וְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּֽעַדְךָ֖ וּבְעַ֣ד הָעָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת־קָרְבַּ֤ן הָעָם֙ וְכַפֵּ֣ר בַּֽעֲדָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them; as Yahweh commanded.”
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the Lord commanded.
controles.livre: E disse Moisés a Arão: Achega-te ao altar, e faze tua expiação, e teu holocausto, e faze a reconciliação por ti e pelo povo: faze também a oferta do povo, e faze a reconciliação por eles; como mandou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרַ֥ב אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּשְׁחַ֛ט אֶת־עֵ֥גֶל הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: So Aaron drew near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
controles.kjv: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
controles.livre: Então chegou-se Arão ao altar; e degolou seu bezerro da expiação que era por ele.

versos.hebraico: וַ֠יַּקְרִבוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֶת־הַדָּם֮ אֵלָיו֒ וַיִּטְבֹּ֤ל אֶצְבָּעוֹ֙ בַּדָּ֔ם וַיִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־קַרְנ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־הַדָּ֣ם יָצַ֔ק אֶל־יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:
controles.kjv: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
controles.livre: E os filhos de Arão lhe trouxeram o sangue; e ele molhou seu dedo no sangue, e pôs sobre as pontas do altar, e derramou o resto do sangue ao pé do altar;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַחֵ֨לֶב וְאֶת־הַכְּלָיֹ֜ת וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֤רֶת מִן־הַכָּבֵד֙ מִן־הַ֣חַטָּ֔את הִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E a gordura e rins e redenho do fígado, da expiação, os fez arder sobre o altar; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַבָּשָׂ֖ר וְאֶת־הָע֑וֹר שָׂרַ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

controles.web: The flesh and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.
controles.kjv: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
controles.livre: Mas a carne e o couro os queimou ao fogo fora do acampamento.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁחַ֖ט אֶת־הָעֹלָ֑ה וַ֠יַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן אֵלָיו֙ אֶת־הַדָּ֔ם וַיִּזְרְקֵ֥הוּ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
controles.kjv: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
controles.livre: Degolou também o holocausto, e os filhos de Arão lhe apresentaram o sangue, a qual espargiu ele ao redor sobre o altar.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הָעֹלָ֗ה הִמְצִ֧יאוּ אֵלָ֛יו לִנְתָחֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־הָרֹ֑אשׁ וַיַּקְטֵ֖ר עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burned them upon the altar.
controles.kjv: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
controles.livre: Apresentaram-lhe depois o holocausto, em pedaços, e a cabeça; e os fez queimar sobre o altar.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ אֶת־הַקֶּ֖רֶב וְאֶת־הַכְּרָעָ֑יִם וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר עַל־הָעֹלָ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

controles.web: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.
controles.kjv: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
controles.livre: Logo lavou os intestinos e as pernas, e queimou-os sobre o holocausto no altar.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת קָרְבַּ֣ן הָעָ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֔ם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵ֥הוּ וַֽיְחַטְּאֵ֖הוּ כָּרִאשֽׁוֹן׃

controles.web: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.
controles.kjv: And he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
controles.livre: Ofereceu também a oferta do povo, e tomou o bode macho que era para a expiação do povo, e degolou-o, e o ofereceu pelo pecado como o primeiro.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרֵ֖ב אֶת־הָעֹלָ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲשֶׂ֖הָ כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
controles.kjv: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
controles.livre: E ofereceu o holocausto, e fez segundo o rito.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרֵב֮ אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה֒ וַיְמַלֵּ֤א כַפּוֹ֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וַיַּקְטֵ֖ר עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ מִלְּבַ֖ד עֹלַ֥ת הַבֹּֽקֶר׃

controles.web: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.
controles.kjv: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
controles.livre: Ofereceu também a oferta de cereais, e encheu dela sua mão, e o fez queimar sobre o altar, também do holocausto da manhã.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁחַ֤ט אֶת־הַשּׁוֹר֙ וְאֶת־הָאַ֔יִל זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֑ם וַ֠יַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן אֶת־הַדָּם֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַיִּזְרְקֵ֥הוּ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar,
controles.kjv: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
controles.livre: Degolou também o boi e o carneiro em sacrifício pacífico, que era do povo: e os filhos de Arão lhe apresentaram o sangue (o qual espargiu ele sobre o altar ao redor),

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַחֲלָבִ֖ים מִן־הַשּׁ֑וֹר וּמִן־הָאַ֔יִל הָֽאַלְיָ֤ה וְהַֽמְכַסֶּה֙ וְהַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְיֹתֶ֖רֶת הַכָּבֵֽד׃

controles.web: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver:
controles.kjv: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
controles.livre: E a gordura do boi; e do carneiro a cauda com o que cobre as entranhas, e os rins, e o redenho do fígado:

versos.hebraico: וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶת־הַחֲלָבִ֖ים עַל־הֶחָז֑וֹת וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר הַחֲלָבִ֖ים הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

controles.web: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar:
controles.kjv: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
controles.livre: E puseram a gordura sobre os peitos, e ele queimou a gordura sobre o altar:

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣ת הֶחָז֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֔ין הֵנִ֧יף אַהֲרֹ֛ן תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.
controles.kjv: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the Lord; as Moses commanded.
controles.livre: Porém os peitos, com a coxa direita, moveu-os Arão por oferta movida diante do SENHOR; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־ידו אֶל־הָעָ֖ם וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֑ם וַיֵּ֗רֶד מֵעֲשֹׂ֧ת הַֽחַטָּ֛את וְהָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃

controles.web: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
controles.kjv: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
controles.livre: Depois levantou Arão suas mãos até o povo e abençoou-os: e desceu de fazer a expiação, e o holocausto, e o sacrifício pacífico.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וַיֵּ֣צְא֔וּ וַֽיְבָרֲכ֖וּ אֶת־הָעָ֑ם וַיֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־כָּל־הָעָֽם׃

controles.web: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the people.
controles.kjv: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the people.
controles.livre: E entraram Moisés e Arão no tabernáculo do testemunho; e saíram, e bendisseram ao povo: e a glória do SENHOR se apareceu a todo o povo.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתֹּ֨אכַל֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אֶת־הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־הַחֲלָבִ֑ים וַיַּ֤רְא כָּל־הָעָם֙ וַיָּרֹ֔נּוּ וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
controles.kjv: And there came a fire out from before the Lord, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
controles.livre: E saiu fogo de diante do SENHOR, e consumiu o holocausto e a gordura sobre o altar; e vendo-o todo o povo, louvaram, e caíram sobre seus rostos.
